# System and methods

TODO: lander, chambers (C1/C2), sample line, RGA + SCALUP, valve cycle (sealed incubation, sampled
alternately, flushed between experiments).

Processing is the `egcf-processing` pipeline, in five layers:

1. **Layer A**: raw SD-card and surface-telemetry logs parsed into status, RGA, SCALUP, valve,
   system-health, PAR and HOBO tables.
2. **Layer B**: one row per RGA mass-scan cycle.
3. **Layer C**: one row per chamber measurement cycle, averaged from cycle start + settle offset to
   the next valve transition.
4. **Layer D**: benthic flux per experiment, chamber and variable, `dC/dt × V/A` from a linear fit to
   Layer C.
5. **Layer E**: O₂ fluxes classed light/dark by PAR, with R, NCP and GPP and a per-chamber
   Jassby–Platt P–I fit.

TODO: anything specific to the flux sign convention, N₂ from N₂/Ar, H⁺ from pH.

## Turbo pump speed

TODO: aim of the test, setpoints stepped, duration, sample.

```{python}
T = rf.load_turbo()
SETTLE_MIN = T["settle_s"] / 60
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(
    f"Readings within {SETTLE_MIN:g} min of acquisition restarting after each speed change are excluded "
    "from all statistics (settle period, inferred from the saved `in_settle` flag). Statistics are "
    "recomputed from the saved tagged readings with `scripts/turbo_speed_analysis.py`."
)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
```{python}
tsa = rf.tsa
show((rf.style(tsa.fig_timeseries(T["turbo_tagged"], T["speed_changes"], T["settle_s"]), None, 700),
      "Total pressure, measured turbo speed and setpoint; all readings. Grey spans are settle periods, excluded."))
```
:::

::: {.content-visible unless-format="html"}
```{python}
show((rf.turbo_timeseries_static(T),
      "Total pressure and measured turbo speed as 1-minute means, with the commanded setpoint. Grey spans "
      "are settle periods, excluded."))
```
:::

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(rf.turbo_tp_table(T))
print("\n: Total pressure and pump power by setpoint, settle excluded. {#tbl-tp-by-speed}")
```

```{python}
seg = T["mass_stats_by_segment"]
show((tsa.fig_mass_facets(seg, "torr_mean", "torr_std", "partial pressure (Torr)", log_y=True),
      "Mean partial pressure (± sd) per mass and hold against setpoint; down and up legs separately."))
show((tsa.fig_mass_facets(seg, "rsd_pct", None, "RSD (%)", log_y=False, hover_fmt=".3g"),
      "RSD per mass and hold, including slow drift."))
show((tsa.fig_rsd(seg, T["rsd_speed_tests"]),
      "Drift-robust RSD (sd of successive differences / √2, over the hold mean) by mass and hold. p is a "
      "Brown–Forsythe test for a setpoint effect, Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted across masses."))
show((tsa.fig_tp(T["tp_by_segment"]), "Total pressure against measured speed, per hold (mean ± sd)."))
show((tsa.fig_power(T["tp_by_segment"]), "Turbo power against measured speed, per hold (mean ± sd)."))
show((tsa.fig_noise_vs_signal(seg),
      "Drift-robust noise and RSD against mean signal, one point per mass and hold, coloured by setpoint, "
      "with the fitted noise model (floor + shot + proportional)."))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(rf.turbo_noise_floor_table(T))
print("\n: Signal, noise and RSD at the lowest setpoint relative to the highest, with BH-adjusted p-values "
      "for a setpoint effect on RSD and on absolute noise. {#tbl-noise-floor}")
```

Ratios to m/z 40 (Ar), the quantity the flux calculations depend on:

```{python}
rseg = T["ratio_stats_by_segment"]
show((tsa.fig_mass_facets(rseg, "ratio_mean", "ratio_std", "signal / m40", log_y=True, hover_fmt=".4g"),
      "Mean ratio to m/z 40 (± sd) per mass and hold."))
show((tsa.fig_rsd(rseg, T["ratio_speed_tests"], label="Drift-robust RSD of signal / m40"),
      "Drift-robust RSD of the ratio to m/z 40, with the setpoint-effect test as above."))
```
